name: npi-providers-mcp-server
description: Search NPPES providers and resolve NUCC specialty codes via MCP over STDIO or Streamable HTTP.

interface.shortDescription: Search NPPES providers and resolve NUCC specialty codes via MCP over STDIO or Streamable HTTP.
interface.longDescription: US healthcare provider directory over the live, keyless NPPES NPI Registry API, plus a bundled NUCC Healthcare Provider Taxonomy code set for offline specialty resolution. Search providers by name, organization, specialty, or location; decode any NPI to its professional-practice record (taxonomies, practice addresses, credentials, identifiers, status — only practice-location addresses are kept for individual providers); and resolve plain-language specialties to taxonomy codes.
